title: Reader Chapter 11
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

breakdown.fullRead: Title: The Phone-Screen Ballot Scenario: After dinner, Claire writes under the handle claireabelle from a bedroom floor, phone balanced on a quilt. The post names a teen relationship, family interactions, and one visible question: break up or not. No one has moved yet. The tiny cursor after the question is doing the narrowing work. What to do: Claire underlines the break-up-or-not wording, then writes two missing questions in the margin: what needs repair with the partner, and what boundary belongs with family.
